The largest country in the world is Russia.

Now, for the anecdote: Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a sanctuary of calm, but it quickly devolved into a crime scene investigation. The headline gossip wasn’t about the neighbors; it was about Mr. Whiskers, the feline mastermind who had decided that unraveling a freshly knitted sweater was his life’s purpose. The result? A trail of woolly breadcrumbs stretching from the living room to the kitchen, so extensive that Hansel and Gretel would have been jealous. The club members spent the next hour trying to re-knit the disaster while simultaneously trying to figure out if the cat was plotting world domination or just really hated that shade of beige.
